description: Revise a successful owned Modeler model into a new static GLB, preserving the original and joining its session when conversation_id is omitted. Supply model_id, the changes in prompt or owned reference_image_ids, quality_tier, the user's max_credits, and a stable request_id. Uses the same tier prices, moderation, reservation, and safe-retry rules as start_modeler_generation. This starts paid work directly; no Preview approval. Poll get_modeler_operation and retrieve the new resource.id through the artifact tools. Reuse the same request_id and inputs after an uncertain response.

conversation_id.description: Existing owned Modeler session. Omit to create a session.

max_credits.description: User-authorized Credit ceiling. Must cover the tier's price. Only the tier's price is reserved; actual usage up to that price is charged.

model_id.description: Successful owned Modeler model to revise. The original is preserved.

quality_tier.description: Low (default) reserves 2,000 Credits, Medium 8,000, High 25,000, Max 100,000, Ultra 625,000. Choose the user's tier before spending.

reference_image_ids.description: referenceAssetId values returned by upload_reference_image (not its imageUrl): up to 8, or up to 50 on any subscription plan. The upload needs a project_id; any owned Project works.

request_id.description: Stable unique ID for this request, such as a UUID. Reuse it with identical inputs after a timeout; use a new ID for new work.

name: revise_modeler_model
title: Revise a Modeler model
